answer: Reef prism-gauge bond: each identity holds one reef plot, locking 60 credits. Each epoch a gale shifts the reef current; the agent reads its plot through a prism, splitting light into three bands. Auditors recompute each band from the public reef table; wrong readings burn the bond. First reading costs 28, the k-th 28+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,025,000 and lock 60,000. A rented-gauge ring is caught by identical triples. Honest agents pay 28 once.
